acceptance_criteria.criterion: Recovery is input-order invariant, non-mutating, stops at the first LSN gap, chooses the lowest containing segment for duplicate LSNs, canonicalizes segment_id to the containing segment, and treats omitted durable_count as zero.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Submission observation 006 exit_code=0 emitted SUBMISSION_WAL_AUTHORED_AUDIT_PASS after exact recovery assertions.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Commit acknowledgment and visible state never advance beyond the contiguous durable LSN prefix even when a higher LSN becomes physically durable first.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Submission observation 006 emitted HIGH_LSN_DURABLE_FIRST_PASS True and asserted no early high-LSN result/state exposure before lower-LSN release.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Concurrent commits remain ordered and recoverable across segment rotation.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Submission observation 006 emitted CONCURRENT_WRITERS_PASS 64; committed LSNs were exactly 1..64 and recovered state matched runtime state.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Runtime state, committed entries, snapshots, recovery inputs, and recovery outputs are detached from caller mutation.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Submission observation 006 passed deep-copy mutation isolation assertions across all outward surfaces.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Recovery remains efficient at moderate scale.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Submission observation 006 replayed 5000 entries in 0.071957 seconds under an authored <3 second bound.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The solution obeys negative constraints: no banned imports, no eval/exec/compile, no disk-write APIs, no typing.Any/cast, and no silent broad-exception pass.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Submission observation 006 static AST audit completed with exit_code=0.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Declared solution runs in a clean Python environment without undeclared third-party dependencies.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Submission observation 006 emitted SUBMISSION_EMPTY_ENV_PASS under env -i with python3 -S.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The previously omitted validated recovery/serializer changes are restored and the same authored acceptance audit passes afterward.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Submission observation 005 restored the already-dev-validated files with exit_code=0; observation 006 reran the same audit and passed.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: No hidden verifier evidence was used before terminal authorization.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: The controller has not invoked verify(); only runtime-visible task files, prior development evidence, and authored checks were used.

verification_commands.command: Authored WAL acceptance audit covering recovery, durability ordering, 64-writer concurrency, detachment, efficiency, static constraints, and clean-environment replay.

transport_replay_reason: The v1 controller began before terminal authorization could exist in its immutable initial checkout. It has not invoked the independent verifier. This v2 session starts with authorization present and replays the same candidate construction plus authored checks before the one allowed verifier invocation.
